text: The paper identifies cosmic spin with observed dark energy. Follow that statement forward, and dark energy requires rotation at 0.828 times the cosmic expansion rate, 1.09 billion times above the generous Planck rotation bound, and 17.6 billion times above the tighter Sade bound. Follow it backward instead, enforcing the generous bound, and rotation supplies less than 1 billion billionth of observed dark energy. The text provides no third reading.
